name: Kolmar Korea

figures.source: MFDS — #2 in Korea by production value. PRODUCTION basis: factory-gate output, not comparable to the revenue row above

read: Korea's #2 ODM by production value (KRW 1.3tn, MFDS 2025) and, on consolidated revenue, marginally larger than Cosmax at KRW 2.722tn (DART) — the gap between the two rankings is the gap between what a company manufactures in Korea and what it books globally. Reported operating profit of KRW 239.6bn with its US subsidiary up 71%, which is the more telling number: Kolmar's growth is coming from serving brands in export markets, not from Korean domestic demand. Together with Cosmax it makes supplier power in Korean BPC a two-name question, and no India-facing activity for either is recorded here.
